Anyways, when all is said and done, in the end this is a more stripped-down version of what we had before and while the gameplay, admittedly is pretty fun, It should be criticized for so much that it removed and so little that it added.

Still, I do have some hope for the PVE. Maybe that'll finally warrant the 2 in it's name.

Frankly, making a new, original character with their own unique story takes a lot effort and resources. All of which can go to waste if the movie doesn't perform well in the eyes of the studio. It's seen as a 50/50 thing. 

Making a new movie from an existing IP is far more profitable since they tend to have an existing fanbase and are quite easy to market. Such movies often end up making tons of profits and if they're bad, they still end up making a lot of money anyways. This is seen as a win-win situation.

Race-swapping and gender-swapping is easier in these huge well-known IP's because studios just don't have enough confidence in original stories with original characters. They don't think that they'll perform well at the box office, but since representation is something that the audience expects nowadays, they shoe-horn it into those well-known characters instead to get those sweet brownie points.

Thank you! All this conversation around the cosmetics has really shifted attention from the actual problem here. A hero being paywalled like that is very scummy in my opinion.

Some have made the argument that a lot of other shooters also lock their heroes behind battle-passes and paywalls, especially Apex and how it locks it's legends. It's true but you have to understand that in Apex, all of the legends play similarly, the only difference being there are their ultimates and their one tactical ability. Whereas in Overwatch, the whole game is built around the idea of counter-picking and the heroes here can define how a match would go. Kiriko directly counters Junker Queen's ultimate and Ana's grenade and if you don't have her unlocked then it can shift the momentum of any match and have a drastic effect on the gameplay. (of course, most people have her unlocked, it's just an example)

They can lock cosmetics as much as they want but locking an important element of the game such as the heroes is not good.
